subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Find key words in profiles and match them with photo boards.
Understand and use new words: valley, cover, busy, background, stadium.
Use phrasal verbs like take up, join in and hang out correctly.

tf.s: A photo board shows images and ideas about your interests and personality.
tf.why: That's why it tells us about a person's identity.

tf.s: In multiple matching, it is enough if one piece of information matches.
tf.why: All the information must match, not just one part.
It shows his city, football, karate and friends.

tf.s: Cody loves playing sport every day.
tf.why: Cody is keen on sport, but only watching it, not playing it.

tf.s: Hana's hobbies are cooking and travelling.
tf.why: Her key words show cooking and travelling.

tf.s: 'Take up' means to stop doing a hobby.
tf.why: 'Take up' means to start a new hobby or activity.

tf.s: The Hiking Club is a good choice for Brooke.
tf.why: Brooke likes being outdoors and meeting people.

tf.s: A stadium is a quiet place in the mountains.
tf.why: A stadium is a big place where people watch sports games.

tf.s: 'Pick up' can mean to learn something new without formal study.
tf.why: For example: 'You will pick up skills quickly.'

tf.s: Key words help you find important information quickly.
tf.why: Underlining key words makes matching faster and easier.

boxes.q: Which photo board belongs to Hana?
boxes.why: Board G matches all of Hana's information.

boxes.q: Who is having karate lessons at the moment?
boxes.why: Osama's profile says he is having karate lessons.

boxes.q: Which word means 'the area behind the main thing in a picture'?
boxes.why: The background is behind the main thing you look at.

boxes.q: Which club is best for Majid?
boxes.why: He is fit and wants competitions at weekends.

boxes.q: Complete: They never ___ when we go hiking.
boxes.why: 'Join in' means to take part in an activity.

boxes.q: Complete: I'm looking ___ to the school trip.
boxes.why: The phrasal verb is 'look forward to'.
Only board C matches all of Kim's information.
We hang out with friends to relax and have fun.

boxes.q: Complete: The magazine has a photo of a footballer on the ___.
boxes.why: The cover is the front of a magazine.
We find out facts or information.

o: A short text that describes a person
mcq.why: Profiles tell us about people's lives and hobbies.
He is keen on sport, but only watching it.

mcq.q: Which phrasal verb completes: I need a racket because I'm going to ___ tennis.
mcq.why: You start a new sport, so you take it up.
Brooke loves the outdoors and meeting people.

mcq.q: Kim plays instruments and makes videos about hairstyles and clothes. Which key words would you underline?
mcq.why: Key words carry the important information about hobbies.

mcq.q: Complete: 'You will ___ skills quickly in our club.'
mcq.why: 'Pick up skills' means learn them easily.

mcq.q: Complete: In the ___ you can see tall mountains.
mcq.why: Mountains far behind the main subject are in the background.

mcq.q: Board B shows a guitar. Why doesn't it match Kim?
o: It doesn't show all of Kim's other information
Guitars are not allowed on boards
Board B has too many photos
mcq.why: In multiple matching, every detail must match.

mcq.q: Why is the Hiking Club right for Brooke but not for Rob?
o: Rob doesn't like nature and wants a creative hobby
mcq.why: Each person's needs decide the right club.

mcq.q: What does the idea 'identity is like a puzzle' mean?
o: Your identity is made of many different parts
Your identity is very hard to find
mcq.why: Family, hobbies and places all fit together to make you.
